command:
set -euo pipefail
# spawn's task shell drops the image PATH; both images keep their env at /opt/conda
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH HOME=/tmp TMPDIR=/tmp PSI_SCRATCH=/tmp
cd /tmp
printf 'bc209e7340173f8234384c06eadc7a6eafe262ce2b583051fd6da869657ecea8  h2.py\n29d6b685d2b48bf16545cc9c273b10497ab10bfefb7750a0979b5ab7422597c6  smoke.py\n' | sha256sum -c || { echo 'FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin'; exit 1; }
echo "== psi4 RHF/STO-3G on H2 at 0.74 A =="
python3 -u h2.py > psi4run.log 2>&1 || { cat psi4run.log; exit 1; }
python3 -u smoke.py > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
cat smoke-check.txt
uname -m
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
